name: systematic-debugging
rationale: This profile owns defect diagnosis and lesson-generation reliability, but its installed inventory has no dedicated debugging method. The skill adds a Hermes-native root-cause workflow without duplicating the existing planning, review, branch-finishing, or verification skills.
risks: Its strict phase ordering can slow trivial diagnosis; apply it proportionally while preserving the root-cause and evidence requirements.

The deliberately strict root-cause-first language can slow emergency containment; use reversible incident mitigation first when required, then complete the root-cause workflow before declaring resolution.
The workflow includes generic shell and test-command examples; use repository-specific commands and retain all project approval, protected-path, capital, and live-trading boundaries.
summary: Four-phase root-cause debugging workflow with reproduction, hypothesis testing, minimal fixes, and regression verification.
